newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Copel launches $500 mln global, local share offer.
newsitem.headline: Copel launches $500 mln global, local share offer.

text.p: Brazilian power utility Copel launched Wednesday a $500 million share offering on local and global markets to raise capital to fund its 1997-98 investment program to expand operations, a company official said.

Mario Roberto Bertoni, Copel's engineering and construction director, told Reuters the company has become the first Brazilian power utility to list American Depositary Shares (ADS) on the New York Stock Exchange.

The Level Three ADS offering totalled $390.4 million, including $292.8 million on the New York Stock Exchange at a price of $18 per share, he said. Copel ELP.N was up 15/16 at 18-15/16 at 1115 EDT/1215 local/1515 GMT in New York.

Another $97.6 million in shares were offered in Europe and Canada at $18 per ADS, while 118.6 million reais ($109.6 million) worth of preferred shares are being offered on Brazilian markets at 19.48 reais per 1,000 shares.
"A Level Three ADR is something that is difficult to get and it was a great challenge for the company," he said. "This shows that U.S., Canadian and European markets have confidence in Copel."
A Level Three ADR or ADS program allows foreign firms to list shares and raise money in the United States.

Bertoni said the funds raised via the 541.1 million real ($500 million) public share offering would be used to build new power plants and substations, install transmission lines and expand Copel's distribution network.
"Some will also be working capital, but all the money will go into our core business," he said.
Copel, formally known as Companhia Paranaense de Energia, is owned by the southern Brazilian state of Parana and there are no immediate plans to privatize the firm, he said.
By bucking the privatization trend, state officials are determined to prove that a state utility, if efficiently run, can be competitive, Bertoni said.
Copel preferred B rose 0.98 percent to 20.55 reais, while its common was flat at 19.50 reais 1223 local time/1123 EDT/1523 GMT in Sao Paulo.
